The Books section publishes the current working versions of the four main volumes directly in the website information architecture.
Use the left sidebar to move between books and chapter sections.

## How these six works relate

AffineDrift publishes two parallel series that converge on the same core idea — control-affine decomposition of human movement — approached from different angles.

| Work | Audience | Status | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|
| Vol I: Tangent-Space Methods | Graduate / researchers | In progress | — |
| Vol II: Control Is Motion | Graduate / researchers | In progress | Vol I |
| Vol III: Biomechanics — Biology to Systems | Grad / practitioners | In progress | Vol I–II helpful |
| Vol IV: Human Motor Control | Grad / practitioners | In progress | Vol I–II helpful |
| Physics of Golf (PoG) | Curious golfers / coaches | In progress | None — self-contained |
| Geometry of Motion (GoM) | Graduate / mathematicians | In progress | Linear algebra, ODEs |

**Recommended entry points by background:**

- *Golfer or coach with no math background* — Start with [Physics of Golf](../articles/The_Physics_of_Golf/quarto/index.html), Chapter 1.
- *Engineer or scientist new to biomechanics* — Start with [Volume I](tangent-space-methods.html), then PoG for applied context.
- *Mathematician or control theorist* — Start with [Geometry of Motion](../articles/The_Geometry_of_Motion/quarto/index.html) Volume 0 (the mathematical primer), then Volume I.
- *Biomechanics researcher* — Start with Volume III; refer back to Volumes I–II for control theory foundations.
